title: Ship video export in the built page
why: Video is the only one of the four declared outputs still at zero, it was in the original ask, and every headline piece in the peer scan is delivered as a film.
what: Walk playheads(piece) in the page and encode with VideoFrame + MediaStreamTrackGenerator + MediaRecorder, paced by a MessageChannel, never rAF or setTimeout. Keep render and encode as separate calls. Assert frames received AND frame spacing, not only count and duration.
notes: Route verified 2026-09-17 by a concurrent session, recorded in its uncommitted edits to ../Docs/Artifex/output-targets.md §2.3-2.6: MediaRecorder needs no ffmpeg; canvas captureStream is paced by the compositor and dropped frames (159/300 at best); MediaStreamTrackGenerator got 300/300; MediaRecorder stamps by wall clock; Chrome clamps timers to 1 s in a background page, so pace on a MessageChannel; one film passed count and duration checks and still juddered, so assert spacing (median 33.3 ms, p95 37.6 ms after the fix). That session owns ../Docs/Artifex/output-targets.md and ../Docs/Artifex/image-substrate.md: coordinate before starting. playheads() is complete and gapless (npm run bench: drift walks 240 frames in 208 ms on a null surface). Findings document: ../Docs/Artifex/output-targets.md — moved out of the repository on 2026-09-19, so the doc field can no longer point at it.

title: Stop fbm octaves aligning on the integer lattice
why: fbm doubles frequency exactly and noise2 is value noise, so the x-gradient vanishes on every integer line: median 1.8e-6 there against 0.35 elsewhere. Anything that differentiates a field inherits that grid.
what: In core/rand.js fbm, multiply frequency by 2.17 per octave (Texturing & Modeling 3rd ed., p. 88) or rotate each octave. Add a test that compares |d/dx| on integer lines with elsewhere, a mutation that restores x2, and remove the KNOWN DEFECT comment on fbm.
notes: Measured with 2.17: 0.28 on integer lines against 0.32 elsewhere (../Docs/Artifex/source-library-scan.md §8.1). This changes every picture that uses fbm (contours, drift, packing) and every seed anyone kept, so the user must accept that before it closes. Pinned fbm values in tests/rand.test.js will move: update them deliberately, never by loosening a check. Findings document: ../Docs/Artifex/source-library-scan.md — moved out of the repository on 2026-09-19, so the doc field can no longer point at it.

title: Add gradient noise to the stochastic source
why: Value noise has a zero derivative across its own lattice lines under any fade that is flat at its ends; gradient noise does not. A field layer that takes gradients or curl needs it.
what: Add an addressed 2D gradient noise (Perlin-style) beside noise2 in core/rand.js, with gradients picked from a fixed table so it stays arithmetic-only and exact in every engine. Test that its derivative on lattice lines is not near zero and that two named fields are independent.
notes: Keep the addressed contract: the gradient at a cell comes from R(name, "grad", cell(i, j)), no stream. No sin or cos, so it stays exact across engines (../Docs/Artifex/procedural-graph-proposal.md §5). Its first reader is the field layer; do not ship it without one. Findings document: ../Docs/Artifex/source-library-scan.md — moved out of the repository on 2026-09-19, so the doc field can no longer point at it.

title: Add an example built on circle inversion and Möbius maps

notes: Indra's Pearls: breadth-first to level 15 holds about 1.2 GB of matrices; depth-first uses constant memory with an adaptive cutoff (../Docs/Artifex/source-library-scan.md §5.1). The cutoff changes detail, never composition, which N7 already allows (core/render.js). Box 9 classifies maps by trace, a testable three-way property. title: Make negative.js mutate a copy instead of the working tree
why: The mutation suite edits the real checkout in place.
